title: See the Future of Agentic AI at LiveRamp’s LAB Demo Day
body_markdown:
## AI is moving at a pace technology has never seen before. Image recognition, speech-to-text, recommendation systems, and capabilities that once defined the cutting edge have become so embedded in products that each individual term has entered everyday use.


At LiveRamp, we’re celebrating more than a year connecting AI to data collaboration networks at full speed.


At the global AI summits we convened last year, we asked over a hundred marketing and technology leaders where they were actually investing in AI - not where the headlines said they should be - and spoke with companies developing AI products and solutions, to map the real opportunity for marketers.


One principle has guided us since day one: cut through the noise and find AI use cases that drive measurable results for brands, publishers, and platforms.


That clarity pushed us into action. Since then, we’ve deliberately focused on three things:


**An ecosystem worth belonging to.** Building on the strength of LiveRamp’s global data collaboration network, we’ve added more than 25 high calibre AI use cases. Our AI partnerships range from sector leaders like[OpenAI](https://liveramp.com/blog/unlocking-better-performance-optimization-and-measurement-for-marketers-in-chatgpt) to early movers like[Firsthand.ai](http://firsthand.ai/) and[Shopsense.ai](http://shopsense.ai/) .


**Proof that it works.** It is early days and we already have multiple case studies demonstrating growth for advertisers. We’re working to showcase further examples every quarter, where AI is driving real returns for clients. For example, LiveRamp’s native Embedded Identity solution on Snowflake drove a 20% overall performance lift for Chalice.


**The infrastructure for what’s next.** At Cannes, we announced[LAB (LiveRamp Agent Builders)](https://liveramp.com/news/liveramp-launches-agentic-partner-program-to-fast-track-agentic-deployments-for-customers) , giving partners and clients the tools to deploy third-party AI agents that can harness the full scale of LiveRamp’s identity, activation, measurement and governance capabilities subject to each client's permissions and LiveRamp's governance controls. Now, we’re ready to showcase it.


Heading into Advertising Week New York 2026, we want to share what we are building with our partners. Our first LAB Demo Day, held during AWNY, will bring together partners and brands to demonstrate what agentic AI looks like when it’s built on LiveRamp’s established infrastructure. For example, explore how we helped[Newton Research](https://liveramp.com/customer-stories/newton-research) unlock a ‘near unlimited’ level of analytics for its customers.


We’d love to see you at our Ad Week[Demo Day](https://events.liveramp.com/LiveRamp_AI_Demo_Day) . Join us as we share real use cases for marketers! .


You can always reach out directly atAI@liveramp.com.
